# Pilot B: decode accuracy against exposure (generated by psych_digits.py summary)

Exposure = cumulative learned encoding units (groups + ungrouped pieces); p = decode accuracy of RS groups, window (n/2, n]; mean over seeds [min-max]. Projected span = s_bar ln2/(-ln p), p smoothed (c+.5)/(n+1). Share = digits inside RS groups / digits.
